---
title: "Subgroup AUROC"
output: html_document
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE, fig.width = 8, fig.height = 5)

library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(readr)
library(stringr)
```

```{r load-data}
base_dir <- "/Users/fuminli/Desktop/CARDIAC-FM"
subgroup_path <- file.path(base_dir, "figure_numbers_new", "supp_subgroups", "subgroups.csv")

subgroups <- read_csv(subgroup_path, show_col_types = FALSE)

arm_labels <- c(
  "RiskScore" = "Risk Score",
  "ECG-FM" = "ECG-FM",
  "CL(ECG)" = "CARDIAC-FM (ECG)",
  "CL(ECG+MRI)" = "CARDIAC-FM (ECG+MRI)",
  "CL(ECG)+RS" = "CARDIAC-FM (ECG) + Risk Score",
  "CL(ECG+MRI)+RS" = "CARDIAC-FM (ECG+MRI) + Risk Score"
)

arm_order <- c(
  "CARDIAC-FM (ECG)",
  "CARDIAC-FM (ECG) + Risk Score",
  "CARDIAC-FM (ECG+MRI)",
  "CARDIAC-FM (ECG+MRI) + Risk Score"
)

arm_colors <- c(
  "CARDIAC-FM (ECG)" = "#D62728",
  "CARDIAC-FM (ECG) + Risk Score" = "#1F77B4",
  "CARDIAC-FM (ECG+MRI)" = "#FF7F0E",
  "CARDIAC-FM (ECG+MRI) + Risk Score" = "#2CA02C"
)

subgroup_labels <- c(
  "ALL" = "Overall",
  "male" = "Male",
  "female" = "Female",
  "age>=65" = "Age >=65",
  "age<65" = "Age <65",
  "age>=75" = "Age >=75",
  "age<75" = "Age <75"
)

outcome_labels <- c(
  "af5" = "Atrial Fibrillation",
  "hf5" = "Heart Failure"
)

plot_subgroup <- function(cohort_name, x_limits = c(0.55, 0.95)) {
  plot_arms <- if (cohort_name == "UKBB") {
    c("CL(ECG)", "CL(ECG)+RS", "CL(ECG+MRI)", "CL(ECG+MRI)+RS")
  } else {
    c("CL(ECG)", "CL(ECG)+RS")
  }
  legend_rows <- if (cohort_name == "UKBB") 2 else 1

  cohort_data <- subgroups %>%
    filter(cohort == cohort_name, arm %in% plot_arms) %>%
    mutate(
      arm_label = factor(arm_labels[arm], levels = arm_order),
      subgroup_label = subgroup_labels[subgroup],
      subgroup_label = factor(
        subgroup_label,
        levels = unique(subgroup_labels[c("ALL", "male", "female", "age>=75", "age<75", "age>=65", "age<65")])
      ),
      outcome_label = factor(outcome_labels[outcome], levels = outcome_labels[c("af5", "hf5")])
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(arm_label), !is.na(subgroup_label), !is.na(outcome_label))

  ggplot(cohort_data, aes(x = auroc, y = subgroup_label, color = arm_label, shape = arm_label)) +
    geom_errorbarh(
      aes(xmin = lo, xmax = hi),
      position = position_dodge(width = 0.72),
      height = 0.22,
      linewidth = 0.45
    ) +
    geom_point(position = position_dodge(width = 0.72), size = 2.6) +
    facet_wrap(~outcome_label, nrow = 1) +
    scale_color_manual(values = arm_colors, drop = TRUE) +
    scale_shape_manual(values = c(16, 15, 17, 18), drop = TRUE) +
    guides(
      color = guide_legend(nrow = legend_rows),
      shape = guide_legend(nrow = legend_rows)
    ) +
    coord_cartesian(xlim = x_limits) +
    labs(x = "AUROC", y = NULL, color = NULL, shape = NULL) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 20) +
    theme(
      axis.title.x = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
      strip.text = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
      legend.text = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
      legend.position = "top",
      panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
    )
}
```

```{r ukbb-subgroup, fig.width=9, fig.height=5.5}
plot_subgroup("UKBB")
```

```{r chs-subgroup, fig.width=9, fig.height=5.5}
plot_subgroup("CHS")
```

```{r mesa-subgroup, fig.width=9, fig.height=5}
plot_subgroup("MESA")
```
